paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.71% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.69%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.60%). Brent crude changed -2.80% to 110.0. Gold changed -0.50% to 4,040.3. Bitcoin changed +0.32% to 81,573.7031. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.953%, a relative move of -3.75%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+8.38%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-6.26%) moved the most.
